title: Battle of Vedrosha
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Vedrosha", at revision 1371144805, opens: "The Battle of Vedrosha was fought near the Vedrosha river, close to Dorogobuzh on 14 July 1500, during the Second Muscovite–Lithuanian War (1500–1503)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2034641, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1500 battle in Europe". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
